name: Crowley St. Croix Container Terminal - Wilfred "Bomba" Allick Port & Transshipment Center, St. Croix, USVI
type: Marine terminal / container port (multipurpose, Ro-Ro + Lo-Lo)

fieldNotes.siteIdentification: Crowley Caribbean Services operates its St. Croix container service out of the Wilfred 'Bomba' Allick Port & Transshipment Center ('The Containerport') on the SOUTH shore of St. Croix at the mouth of the Krause Lagoon dredged channel, immediately west of the former HOVENSA / Limetree Bay refinery tank farm and its product piers. It is NOT in downtown Christianston (the mailing city is Christiansted 00823 but the facility sits ~10km SW of the town on the industrial south coast). VIPA owns the port; Crowley and Tropical Shipping are the two long-time tenant carriers. Per VIPA, it is a ~45-acre VIPA parcel with a 1,000 ft dock, 2 berths (vessels to 525 ft, 30 ft draft), Ro-Ro + Lo-Lo, and a 30-ton gantry crane. The audited yard polygon is the ~12-acre active paved working-yard + marginal wharf footprint at lat 17.6943, lng -64.7616 (the wider VIPA parcel includes adjacent scrub/laydown not in active container use).
fieldNotes.yardSpots: The 'yard spots' figure (trailerParkingCapacity ~400) is CONTAINER/CHASSIS GROUND SLOTS, not warehouse dock-door positions. It is a CONSERVATIVE RANGE estimate (roughly 300-500 ground slots) from the paved working yard south and east of the transit shed. The yard appeared lightly used / sparsely stacked with creeping vegetation in the imagery, so live utilization is far below capacity; the number is theoretical ground-slot capacity of the paved area. Low confidence - island imagery is moderate-res and the working surface is irregular.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Marine container terminal - NO warehouse dock-door bank. The single large flat-roofed building north of the yard is a transit shed / cargo shed, not a dock-door warehouse. dockDoorCount = 0; dockDoors band = NONE. Cargo moves over the marginal wharf (Ro-Ro ramp + Lo-Lo gantry), not through truck dock doors.
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED controlled entry. Street View (pano @ 17.6955,-64.7626, captured 2016-08) at the access road shows a chain-link perimeter fence with a swing gate across the road and a security/RANGER pickup truck with a person standing at the checkpoint. The terminal perimeter is fenced (chain-link visible around the tanks and yard in both 2016 and 2024 SV captures). truckGate = true, single entrance, entryExitTogether.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No fixed glass-walled guard booth resolved in imagery; the checkpoint appears to be a manned gate (ranger/security vehicle present) rather than a permanent booth structure. Set guardShack=false and remoteGs=true (gate present, no clear booth - manned/kiosk-style control). Both flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The unpaved/gravel access road from the gate runs a long approach (several hundred meters of road and open yard between the perimeter gate and the wharf/working face), so a truck queue stacks well off the public road. drivewayLong=true, postGateStaging=true (ample paved/unpaved holding inside the gate before the working face).
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: NOT backup-sensitive - the gate sits on a remote industrial access road on the undeveloped south coast with abundant stacking room inside and outside; a queue would not spill onto a busy public road. backupSensitive=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: RURAL. The setting is remote south-coast industrial land - coastal scrub, gravel roads, the abandoned refinery, no town fabric. Street View shows unpaved roads and dense bush. urbanRural=Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Inferred true - remote south-shore location far from the island's towns (Christiansted/Frederiksted) on undeveloped coast; cellular coverage at the wharf is plausibly weak. Medium-confidence inference, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail anywhere on St. Croix. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale resolved in imagery; flagged uncertain (a port of this type often has a weighbridge at the gate, but none was visible).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 2 = the large transit shed + the cluster of bulk storage tanks/associated small structure treated as the second built feature; conservative, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.imageryNote: Island imagery is moderate resolution and the terminal was lightly used in the captures (sparse stacks, encroaching vegetation on the paved yard). All counts are conservative estimates; overall confidence LOW per the marine-terminal / poor-island-coverage convention.
